import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveView } from '@src/api/bot/cave-command';
import type { CaveOverviewPlot } from '@src/api/schemas/cave-overview-query';
import { ownPlotActions } from '@src/response/cavePlot/capabilities';
import { sendLingzhiGuidePromptPage, sendProfessionAndCaveLockedPage, sendSelfCavePlotPage } from '@src/response/cavePlot/render';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

type CavePlotPresentation = {
  plotIndex: number;
  plotState: 'cultivated' | 'unlockable' | 'locked';
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionCommand?: string;
  actions: Array<{ label: string; command: string }>;
};

// Plot title, state description and command eligibility are authoritative Go
// display facts. The bot only selects its Markdown layout.
function plotPresentation(plot: CaveOverviewPlot): CavePlotPresentation {
  return {
    plotIndex: plot.plotIndex,
    plotState: plot.plotState,
    title: plot.title,
    detail: plot.detail,
    actionLabel: ownPlotActions(plot)[0]?.label,
    actionCommand: ownPlotActions(plot)[0]?.command,
    actions: ownPlotActions(plot)
  };
}

export function presentBackendCavePlots(plots: CaveOverviewPlot[]): CavePlotPresentation[] {
  return plots.map(plotPresentation);
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const { access, overview } = await getBackendCaveView(String(bid), uid);

  if (!access.canUseCave) {
    sendProfessionAndCaveLockedPage({
      title: '洞府灵田',
      bid,
      isPrivate,
      message,
      leadText: access.lockedMessage
    });

    return;
  }
  if (!access.hasCavePlot) {
    sendLingzhiGuidePromptPage({ title: '洞府灵田', bid, isPrivate, message });

    return;
  }
  if (!overview) {
    throw new Error('洞府概览缺失');
  }

  sendSelfCavePlotPage({
    title: '洞府灵田',
    bid,
    isPrivate,
    message,
    showOperations: /(?:我的灵田|灵田|我的洞府|洞府)\s+操作\s*$/.test(e.MessageText ?? ''),
    showManagement: /(?:我的灵田|灵田|我的洞府|洞府)\s+经营\s*$/.test(e.MessageText ?? ''),
    selectedPlotIndex: (() => {
      const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').match(/\s+地块\s+(\d+)\s*$/);

      return match ? Number(match[1]) : undefined;
    })(),
    plots: presentBackendCavePlots(overview.plots),
    stasisFormation: overview.stasisFormation ?? undefined
  });
});
